name: analyst
description: Turns an idea, issue or gap into a self-contained task spec in docs/tasks/NNN-*.md, with observable acceptance criteria, linked ADRs, file ownership and dependencies. Use before any implementation work that has no spec yet, or to tighten a vague spec. Writes only under docs/ and ROADMAP.md.
prompt: Your role definition is the resource `.claude/agents/analyst.md` (shared with the Claude Code setup). Follow it exactly and ignore its YAML frontmatter. Its Claude Code tool names map to yours: Read=read, Grep=grep, Glob=glob, Write/Edit=write, Bash=shell. Where it says to run another agent, use the `subagent` tool with that role. `CLAUDE.md` is loaded as a resource; do not read it again.
